eyebrow.zh: 给不可信输入显式打标，沿已插桩的工具调用传播标签，列出受影响且有副作用的动作。
eyebrow.en: Explicitly label untrusted inputs, propagate provenance through instrumented tool calls, and report affected side-effecting actions.

headline.zh:
从一个来源，
追到受影响的动作
headline.en:
Start with a source.
Trace the affected actions.

sub.zh: 给不可信输入显式打标，沿已插桩的工具调用传播标签，列出受影响且有副作用的动作。
sub.en: Explicitly label untrusted inputs, propagate provenance through instrumented tool calls, and report affected side-effecting actions.

caption.zh: 显式标签 · 工具依赖

body.zh: 每个标签有来源 ID 和原因。
body.en: Each label has a source ID and reason.

body.zh: 依赖图保留标签能到达的动作。
body.en: The dependency graph retains actions reached by labels.

body.zh: 受影响只读动作与需复查写入分别展示。
body.en: Affected read-only actions and side effects are shown separately.

body.zh: 只记录动作名，很难知道某个输出是否用到了不可信内容。TaintTrace 要求接入方在边界打标，并通过 tracked 工具保留传播关系。报告按记录中的依赖和副作用标记给出复查清单，不自行判断内容是否恶意，也不自动隔离运行中的动作。
body.en: An action log alone does not identify which outputs used untrusted content. TaintTrace relies on boundary labels and tracked tools to preserve propagation. It reports a review list from recorded dependencies and side-effect flags; it neither decides whether content is malicious nor automatically isolates running actions.

body.zh: 真实执行内置 11 动作场景与一个 3 动作脚本，验证标签传播和报告。动作名称中的网络、提交或发送行为均为模拟，clean 只表示在该记录图中没有追溯到标签。
body.en: The real built-in eleven-action scenario and a three-action script exercise propagation and reporting. Network, commit and send names are simulated; clean only means no label was reached in the recorded graph.

alt.zh: 真实执行内置 11 动作场景与一个 3 动作脚本，验证标签传播和报告。动作名称中的网络、提交或发送行为均为模拟，clean 只表示在该记录图中没有追溯到标签。
alt.en: The real built-in eleven-action scenario and a three-action script exercise propagation and reporting. Network, commit and send names are simulated; clean only means no label was reached in the recorded graph.

body.zh: label.py 定义标签集合，wrap.py 在同步或异步工具输入输出之间传播标签，Tracker 可记录 JSONL。graph.py 重建依赖图，quarantine.py 计算可达动作并筛选 side_effect。CLI 提供表格、图和 JSON。
body.en: label.py defines label sets; wrap.py propagates them through synchronous or asynchronous tool inputs and outputs, with optional JSONL recording by Tracker. graph.py rebuilds dependencies, and quarantine.py computes reachable actions and filters side effects. The CLI supplies tables, graphs and JSON.

alt.zh: label.py 定义标签集合，wrap.py 在同步或异步工具输入输出之间传播标签，Tracker 可记录 JSONL。graph.py 重建依赖图，quarantine.py 计算可达动作并筛选 side_effect。CLI 提供表格、图和 JSON。
alt.en: label.py defines label sets; wrap.py propagates them through synchronous or asynchronous tool inputs and outputs, with optional JSONL recording by Tracker. graph.py rebuilds dependencies, and quarantine.py computes reachable actions and filters side effects. The CLI supplies tables, graphs and JSON.

body.zh: 标签传播依赖被包装的数据与调用关系。未插桩路径、未标记输入或丢失标签的转换都可能让图不完整；报告里的 proven clean 不是整个系统的安全证明。
body.en: Propagation depends on wrapped data and call relationships. Uninstrumented paths, unlabeled inputs or label-losing conversions can leave the graph incomplete. The report’s proven clean wording is not a security proof for the whole system.

alt.en: Propagation depends on wrapped data and call relationships. Uninstrumented paths, unlabeled inputs or label-losing conversions can leave the graph incomplete. The report’s proven clean wording is not a security proof for the whole system.

body.zh: quarantine 是分析结果列表，接入方决定如何复查或恢复。
body.en: quarantine is an analysis list; the integration decides how to review or recover.

note.zh: 真实执行内置 11 动作场景与一个 3 动作脚本，验证标签传播和报告。动作名称中的网络、提交或发送行为均为模拟，clean 只表示在该记录图中没有追溯到标签。
note.en: The real built-in eleven-action scenario and a three-action script exercise propagation and reporting. Network, commit and send names are simulated; clean only means no label was reached in the recorded graph.

body.zh: 在模拟函数中运行 11 条动作的标签链。
body.en: Run the eleven-action label flow through simulated functions.

body.zh: 3 动作中 2 条受标签影响，1 条有副作用标记。
body.en: Two of three actions carry the label; one has a side-effect flag.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。下面的全部工具函数都是本地 fixture，无网络、真实文件写入或消息发送。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. All demo tool functions are local fixtures, with no network, real file writes or messages.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/tainttrace.git
cd tainttrace
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.zh: 必须显式标记和插桩，不能自动追踪任意 Agent 的所有 token。
limitations.en: Explicit labels and instrumentation are required; arbitrary agent tokens are not automatically tracked.

limitations.zh: clean 仅相对于记录图，不表示没有其他未观测影响。
limitations.en: Clean is relative to the recorded graph and does not rule out unobserved influence.

limitations.zh: 不会自动回滚、阻断工具或证明注入已成功利用。
limitations.en: The tool does not roll back, block tools or prove successful exploitation.
